PLAINTIFF’S MOTION FOR LEAVE TO APPEAR REMOTELY
AT THE SEPTEMBER 25, 2026 HEARING

Plaintiff Marvelle J. Ballentine moves for leave to appear by videoconference or, in the
alternative, by telephone at the hearing set for September 25, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. in Alexandria
Courtroom 301 before Magistrate Judge Ivan D. Davis on Plaintiff’s Motion for Leave to Serve
Three Limited Interrogatories on NCMEC before the Rule 26(f) Conference (ECF No. 15) and
Plaintiff’s Motion for Leave to File a Supplemental Complaint (ECF No. 26). In support, Plaintiff
states as follows.

1. Good cause supports the request. Plaintiff appears pro se and resides in Florida. In-
person attendance at the hearing would require interstate travel and its attendant expense.

2. Both motions are fully briefed. The Rule 26(d)(1) motion is before the Court on the
motion and memorandum (ECF Nos. 15, 16), NCMEC’s opposition (ECF No. 33), and Plaintiff’s
reply (ECF No. 36). The Rule 15(d) motion is before the Court on the motion and memorandum
(ECF Nos. 26, 27), NCMEC’s opposition (ECF No. 32), and Plaintiff’s reply (ECF No. 35).

Remote appearance permits Plaintiff to participate fully in argument on these written motions.

Case 1:26-cv-02331-RDA-IDD Document 41 Filed 08/31/26 Page 2 of 4 PagelD# 403

3. Plaintiff will be available by videoconference or telephone at the Court’s
convenience, will comply with all connection instructions issued by the Court or the Clerk, and will
bear any cost of his remote appearance.

4. This Motion does not seek to continue the hearing. Plaintiff will appear at the date
and time set by the Court.

5. Plaintiff conferred with counsel before filing this Motion. Counsel for Defendant
National Center for Missing & Exploited Children stated that his clients take no position on
Plaintiff’s request to appear remotely at the September 25, 2026 hearing. Counsel for Defendant
Meta Platforms, Inc. stated that Meta takes no position on the request.

WHEREFORE, Plaintiff respectfully requests leave to appear by videoconference or, in the
alternative, by telephone at the September 25, 2026 hearing. A proposed order accompanies this

Motion.

Date: August 31, 2026 Respectfully submitted,

YD

Marvelle J. Ballentine

Plaintiff, pro se
